title: Building – Egress requirements in the 2006 Alberta Building Code – January 2018
description: An owner renovated a third-floor bedroom in a three-storey group home, adding a dormer to raise the ceiling height. The municipality found the third level no longer met the dwelling-unit travel limit to exits or egress doors.

refusal.basis: analogous: order appeal. The panel noted earlier alternative solutions were not acceptable or 'did not provide an equivalent level of safety'.

outcome_summary: Order varied to allow an egress window in any third-level bedroom, and/or a balcony per 9.9.9.1.(3), or an alternative solution acceptable to the municipality, by 14 Mar 2018. The vacate directive remains.
